scope: Frozen read-only/low-impact preflight, not a build or VM result. The later live source build is outside this archive.
cleanup_scope: Four reproducible ignored Cargo target caches removed by parent before preflight; their adjacent logs/evidence preserved. Preflight performed no cleanup.

warnings.detail: BusyBox v1.36.1 static lacks script. The packager lists a script symlink, but current minimal/init and fixed boot_hello.sh never invoke script. All actually used applets are present; no source change made.

target_scope_notes: cc-1.2.22 is referenced only by iana-time-zone-haiku-0.1.2 in the standalone OSDK lock; cached iana-time-zone manifest gates that package on target_os=haiku.
rustversion-1.0.20 is referenced only by wasm-bindgen-0.2.100; cached parent manifests gate wasm-bindgen branches on wasm targets.

jiff-static-0.2.13 is optional and also listed under cfg(any()) (always false); portable-atomic-util-0.2.4 is gated on not(target_has_atomic="ptr"). These missing lock entries do not directly demonstrate an x86 build blocker.
Target-specific offline Cargo build is the remaining execution check; this read-only review deliberately did not resolve feature/target graphs.
offline_cache.limitation: 33 whole-lock OSDK cache gaps are mostly non-native/inactive branches; the native target graph and actual offline build remain execution checks, not presumed failures or successes.

command_output_storage: Every actual tool argv, cwd, raw exit, full stdout/stderr, executable path/SHA and selected environment is embedded once in next6-build-preflight.json; no redundant per-tool log copies.

original_repository_preexisting_manifest.action: Read-only observation; never removed or modified by preflight.
